name: West Lothian
title: West Lothian —
tagline: Linlithgow Palace, the birthplace of Mary, Queen of Scots, and the shale bings of an industrial past.
summary: West Lothian lies between Edinburgh and Glasgow. It has Linlithgow Palace, the birthplace of Mary Queen of Scots, and a landscape marked by the red bings of the shale oil industry.
Livingston, a new town built in the 1960s, is its largest town, and the area has strong links with the Bathgate engineering tradition.
